== Summary ==
Decipher's errata for Dengar With Blaster Carbine: the entry “Dengar With Blaster Carbine” in Decipher's ''Star Wars CCG Glossary Supplement'' (updated 29 January 2002), PDF page 3. Image for [[Dengar With Blaster Carbine (Decipher Errata 2002)]].

Source: [http://www.decipher.com/starwars/rules/pdf/swccgglossarysupplement.pdf swccgglossarysupplement.pdf], archived copy [https://web.archive.org/web/20041106202626/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/rules/pdf/swccgglossarysupplement.pdf 20041106202626]; wiki copy [[Media:Decipher_Glossary_Supplement.pdf|Decipher_Glossary_Supplement.pdf]] (SHA-1 <code>3f9a040eca571154b142ffc52e3ac36f16045c02</code>). Cut unchanged from a 300 dpi render of PDF page 3 (pdftoppm -r 300), around the entry's title and revised game text with a 6-point margin.
